summary.text: Vaneta Becker is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 50, which covers Warrick County and portions of Vanderburgh County, since 2005, after serving in the Indiana House of Representatives from 1981 to 2005.
She serves on the Health and Provider Services, Local Government, and Public Policy committees.

paragraphs.text: According to her Indiana Senate Republican biography, Becker earned a B.S. from the University of Southern Indiana and is a real estate broker with F.C. Tucker Emge Realtors.
She served on the Indiana Commission for Women and co-chaired the Advisory Board of the Office of Women's Health at the Indiana State Department of Health.

Her listed honors include the Civility in Government Award from the Association of Retired Members of the Indiana General Assembly (2015) and a Distinguished Alumni Award from the University of Southern Indiana (1995).
The page identifies her as a member of the United Methodist Church, married to Andy Guarino.
